subject: MAP Weekly Checkpoint — performance snapshot & ops playbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@scaleclinical.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Weekly Checkpoint — performance snapshot & ops playbook

Hi Sarah,

Following up from last week's demo — here's the short weekly MAP checkpoint focused on the performance benchmark we ran against your evaluation suite. Attached is a concise perf_summary_q1.pdf and the working MAP Excel (map-v2-timeline.xlsx).

Top-line results (from last-run, batch=auto, seq_len=1024):
- p50 latency: 78 ms
- p95 latency: 230 ms
- sustained throughput (tokens/sec): 4,200 t/s on a 4xA100 pool
- median token cost: $0.00035/token (hosted profiling)
- KV cache hit-rate observed: 62% (reasonable prefix repeat in test set)

Observed issues:
- p95 spikes correlate with the 1% of requests that included long tool-calls (avg 1.8x longer).
- Small payloads (seq_len<128) had suboptimal batching; average batch size was 1.7 for those flows.

Proposal (short list of next tuning steps):
1) Increase small-payload batching window from 10ms -> 25ms for ScaleClinical's route to push median batch size to ~3 (Owner: Karthik; due: 2026-03-25).
2) Enable KV prefix caching for the 3 largest prompt templates (Owner: Marcus; due: 2026-03-29).
3) Add a guarded fallback model (lower-quant variant) for capacity spikes; Redwood will run a 24h cost/quality simulation (Owner: Priyom; due: 2026-03-30).
4) Run a targeted eval comparing 4-bit quantized variant on your prompt set focusing on hallucination rate (Owner: Evelyn; due: 2026-04-02).

Would you be able to confirm: the recovery SLA expectation (p95 < 350ms) and whether you want a hard guardrail (auto-failover to dedicated pool) or a soft one (queue + notify)?

Next sync: proposed Tue 24 Mar, 11:00 PT — 20 min standup to review tuning runs. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0152
